records.title: Deliver the Forest Run native Android endless-runner experience
records.objective: Provide the authored landscape Android game and the forest journey from willow through five biomes, Seeds/Bloom/encounters, Rest and a persistent Garden.
records.completion_conditions: Current intended game loop and its owners are documented; source/runtime verification is candidate- and phase-specific.

records.title: Preserve fair, deterministic and state-owned gameplay mechanics
records.objective: Ensure movement, encounter arbitration, encounter outcomes, score/Seed/Bloom and progression obey their documented contracts.
records.status: WOLF_CHARGE source correction and local/exact-SHA host/API35 verification complete; physical/human acceptance remains separately tracked.
records.completion_conditions: Each requirement has source ownership and appropriate independent behavioral evidence on the intended candidate.

records.title: Carry meaningful forest history across runs and sessions
records.objective: Persist Garden, relationships, wardrobe, history, ghosts, return moments and memory projections with domain-specific recovery and read-only Journal presentation.
records.completion_conditions: Documented persistence authorities and recovery behavior are reconciled to source and candidate checks where authorized.

records.title: Provide accessible interaction and comfort-aware presentation
records.objective: Expose truthful accessibility semantics and actions, readable UI and lifecycle-correct transient audio/haptic/visual feedback.
records.status: implemented_static_evidence; current UI/feedback delta inspected in changed regions
records.completion_conditions: Source contracts, focused regressions and physical/human acceptance evidence are separately satisfied.

records.title: Construct trustworthy candidate-bound engineering and release evidence
records.objective: Capture, validate, aggregate and bind deterministic, source, device, human, asset, dependency, package, store and governance evidence to the exact candidate.
records.status: extensive source/docs; modified script delta partially inspected and unverified at runtime
records.completion_conditions: Evidence tools preserve their contracts and all required candidate-bound evidence is real, current and independently reviewable.

records.title: Reach an accountable production release decision
records.objective: Resolve physical/human acceptance, creative and rights decisions, security/privacy and policy, signing, Play delivery and accountable approval for one frozen candidate.
records.completion_conditions: All applicable gates pass for the same frozen candidate and an accountable release decision is recorded.

records.title: Establish that model training is not an applicable project capability

records.completion_conditions: No ML training, dataset or GPU objective is inferred without a new explicit requirement.

records.title: Preserve exhaustive repository knowledge and source-level evidence
records.objective: Complete the evidence-grounded repository knowledge map and coverage/task ledger while reusing prior work and clearly separating static inspection from runtime verification.
sources: user-provided repository investigation and execution-ledger specification (read 2026-10-27)
records.status: Completed evidence-bounded repository knowledge reconstruction and applicability planning. Current inventory: 1,003 paths (950 full static, 17 partial binary metadata/hash-only, 33 documented, 3 excluded); 6,137 unique declaration records across 256 production paths. The applicability matrix covers 19 requirements, 14 universal mechanisms and 13 verification categories. No current source gap was established by the source delta audit; tests/runtime remain prohibited and six future verification tasks are deferred.
records.completion_conditions: Accessible paths have an evidence-backed full/partial/excluded disposition; current goals and source states are traceable; repository-specific universal applicability and risk-based verification choices are documented; prohibited runtime and unresolved external/binary limitations remain explicit.
